name: Dabuyid dynasty
alt: Gilan and Tabaristan under the Dabuyids

predecessors.name: Sasanian Empire
predecessors.text: Gilan and, by treaty with the Arabs, Tabaristan: the Sasanian Padashwargar country

ledger.x: 642: Gil Gavbara founds the Dabuyid dynasty in Gilan.
Year not on the page: Farrukhan the Great (712-728) founded Sari and 'he moved his capital there', with a palace at Shahr-e Espahbodan between Sari and Amol.
716: 'In 716, the Arab governor of Iraq and Khurasan, Yazid ibn al-Muhallab invaded Tabaristan with the intent to conquer it.'

760: al-Tak falls and Khurshid's family is taken to Baghdad; the Tabaristan page: Khurshid 'was defeated in 760 by Abbasid general Abu al-Khasib Marzuq', the first Abbasid governor, who built the great mosque in Sari.
760: the Abbasid conquest of Tabaristan ends with the fall of al-Tak and Khurshid's repulse.

wars.name: Yazid ibn al-Muhallab's invasion of Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Dabuyid victory: Farrukhan the Great contained the invasion; Yazid withdrew 'in return for tribute' and was dismissed in 717.

wars.name: Abbasid conquest of Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Abbasid victory: Tabaristan became an Abbasid province under Marzuq; Khurshid fled to Daylam and died in 761.

certainty.note: Mountain and forest frontiers of Tabaristan and Gilan; Gurgan, Daylam and the Talysh coast are the soft edges (marzban rule, nominal rule).
